name: Hacker News API (Firebase)
summary: Official real-time read-only API for every Hacker News story, comment, job, poll and user.
description: Items (stories, comments, jobs, polls, poll options) and users are exposed as JSON documents on Firebase, with list endpoints for top, new, best, ask, show and job stories and a changed-items feed (updates.json) for incremental sync. Item IDs are sequential integers, so the full history can be walked down from maxitem.json. Firebase streaming (Server-Sent Events) is also supported for live updates.

rate_limit.summary: No published limit (documented as currently none); be polite.

endpoints.summary: Fetch a story, comment, job or poll
User profile and submitted item ids
IDs of up to 500 top stories (also newstories, beststories, askstories, showstories, jobstories)

license.name: No explicit open license; user-generated content under HN/YC terms

agent_notes: Fetching a thread costs one request per item, so budget for N+1 calls. For full-text search use the separate Algolia HN Search API (hn.algolia.com/api/v1). Use maxitem.json and updates.json to sync incrementally.
caveats: No search or filtering in this API.
Deleted or dead items return null or carry deleted/dead flags.
